title: Look at what XLM just did
hook: XLM is setting up. Here's what my scanner caught.

segments.narration: XLM printed the week’s highest confluence score at 11.0 and appeared on the scanner two out of the last seven days, specifically on May 26 and May 28. Eight distinct signals aligned inside the convergence bucket. Volume inside the 20-period window expanded sharply while OBV showed stealth accumulation, indicating large players were absorbing supply without lifting price. RSI printed a bullish divergence against the prior swing low and sat inside the neutral-to-bullish zone, while CMF remained positive, confirming sustained buying pressure. Structurally, price carved a series of higher lows on the four-hour chart, and funding rates stayed negative, removing the long-squeeze fuel that often precedes fakeouts.
